'''C. J. Wilcox''' (born December 30, 1990) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career at the [[University of Washington]] and is considered a probable pick in the [[2014 NBA draft]].

==College career==
Wilcox came to the [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington Huskies]] following a prep career at [[Pleasant Grove High School (Utah)|Pleasant Grove High School]] in [[Pleasant Grove, Utah]].  During his Huskies career he was twice named second team [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pacific-12 Conference]].<ref>{{cite web | last = Allen| first = Percy| title = C.J. Wilcox and Nigel Williams-Goss receive all-conference honors | work = [[Seattle Times]] | date = March 10, 2014| url = http://blogs.seattletimes.com/huskymensbasketball/2014/03/10/c-j-wilcox-and-nigel-williams-goss-receive-all-conference-honors/ | accessdate = May 26, 2014}}</ref>  As a senior, Wilcox averaged 18.3 [[points per game]] and scored 1,880 points in his career.<ref>{{cite web | last = | first = | title = C.J. Wilcox bio | work = [[ESPN.com]] | date = | url = http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/45869/cj-wilcox | accessdate = May 26, 2014}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Following the completion of his college career, Wilcox was invited to the 2014 [[NBA Draft Combine]].  There he performed well in athletic tests and was one of the top shooting players in the combine.<ref>{{cite web | last = Helfgot| first = Mike| title = Pleasant Grove native C.J. Wilcox impressing NBA teams at Chicago combine | work = [[Deseret News]] | date = May 16, 2014| url = http://www.deseretnews.com/article/865603334/Pleasant-Grove-native-CJ-Wilcox-impressing-NBA-teams-at-Chicago-combine.html?pg=all | accessdate = May 26, 2014}}</ref>
